answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Signed plumber licence with plumbing board attestation. It requires a licence the board renews after assessed jobs and exams, so the sparrow of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The mirror is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The wander is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
